question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: Your career is backed by two combinations in the 10th house, where the Sun and Mercury sit together to form Budhaditya yoga and Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The planets that rule and signify work are mostly strong, with Venus exalted and Mars in its own sign, while Saturn, the 10th lord, stays below its required strength [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka]. The career house from the ascendant is itself the weakest point, though the houses supporting it hold up well [vote:career.house].

areas.name: career

claims.text: The Sun and Mercury are conjunct in the 10th house from the lagna, forming Budhaditya yoga, with its result scaled down because Mercury is in an infant or final degree state [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [text:Phaladeepika/Sastri-1937/18/1].

The Sun, lord of the 4th house, is conjunct Mercury, lord of the 2nd and 5th houses, in the 10th house from the lagna, forming Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars forms Ruchaka yoga from the lagna, in the 7th house, and from the Sun, in the 10th house, though weakened by Saturn's aspect, by its adverse tara from the Moon and by its marana karaka sthana placement [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2].

The house test is for career: the 10th house from the lagna, Aquarius, is the weakest house by strength, but the 2nd, 6th and 11th from the lagna and most of the career houses counted from the Moon and the Sun are average or stronger [vote:career.house].

The lord test is for career: Saturn, lord of the 10th, sits in the 1st house in a friend's sign but below its required strength, while Venus, lord of the 6th, is exalted in the 11th and Mars, lord of the 10th counted from the Sun, is strong in its own sign in the 7th [vote:career.lord].

The significator test is for career: the Sun in the 10th in an enemy's sign and Mercury in the 10th in a neutral sign are both above their required strength, Venus is exalted and strong in the 11th, and only Saturn in the 1st falls short of its required strength [vote:career.karaka].

The divisional-chart test is for career: in the dasamsa, Mars is very well placed in Capricorn and Saturn is well placed in Capricorn, the Sun, Jupiter and Venus are mildly well placed, and the Moon and Mercury are neutral [vote:career.varga].

The birth-day test is for career: Mars, ruler of the birth tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th from the lagna and the 10th from the Sun and is above its required strength, and the Moon, ruler of the birth weekday, rules the 10th from the Moon and is above its required strength [vote:career.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: In your chart the Sun and Mercury sit together in the 10th house counted from the lagna (the ascendant, the sign rising at birth), forming Budhaditya yoga, the combination of Mercury and the Sun in the same sign, and Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga, a combination joining the lord of an angular house with the lord of a trine house [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The tradition links these with intellect, communication, authority, reputation and career [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The significator test is for career: the Sun in the 10th in an enemy's sign and Mercury in the 10th in a neutral sign are both above their required strength, Venus is exalted in the 11th and above its required strength, and only Saturn in the 1st falls short of its required strength [vote:career.karaka].

The birth-day test is for career: Mars, ruler of the birth tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th from the lagna and the 10th from the Sun and is above its required strength, and the Moon, ruler of the birth weekday, rules the 10th from the Moon and is above its required strength [vote:career.panchanga].

areas.paragraph: In your chart the Sun and Mercury sit together in the 10th house counted from the lagna (the ascendant, the sign rising at birth), forming Budhaditya yoga, the combination of Mercury and the Sun in the same sign, and Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga, a combination joining the lord of an angular house with the lord of a trine house [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The tradition links Budhaditya yoga with intellect, communication and reputation [rule:yoga.budhaditya]. It links Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga with authority, reputation and career [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. The soft spot is the 10th house itself, the lowest of the houses in strength, and its ruler Saturn falls short of the strength it requires, even though the planets sitting in that house are above their required strength [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka]. Five of the seven tests agree in favour, while two abstain [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga].

The KP test is for partnership: the 7th cusp lies in Saturn's star with Mercury as its sub-lord, and Mercury's star lord Mars, which occupies and owns the 7th, touches the marriage house without any denial house and decides the test, while Mercury itself signifies both the 2nd and the 10th [vote:marriage.kp].
